llc.formation_notes: Statutory fee $135 (Minn. Stat. 322C.0201 subd. 4); SOS fee schedule: $135 by mail, $155 online or in person. The SOS schedule read is dated 2017; current sos.mn.gov pages block automated reading.

annual_report.name: Annual Renewal
annual_report.late_penalty: administrative dissolution if not filed; reinstatement $25 mail / $45 online

state_tax_on_llc.name: Minimum fee (partnerships, incl. multi-member LLCs taxed as partnerships)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: partnerships whose Minnesota property + payroll + sales/receipts is at least $1,250,000 (2025 instructions)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Tiered fee by size of Minnesota factors; single-member disregarded LLCs not subject. 2026 tiers not read.

sources.title: Minn. Stat. 322C.0201
sources.quote: A limited liability company is formed when articles of organization have been filed with the secretary of state accompanied by a payment of $135.

sources.title: MN Secretary of State Business Filing Fee Schedule (rev. 6/19/2017)
sources.quote: Articles of Organization - Original Filing for 322C $135.00 $155.00 ... Annual Renewal for 322B or 322C $0 $0

sources.title: 2025 Form M8 instructions
sources.quote: An S corporation is subject to a minimum fee if the sum of its Minnesota source property, payroll and sales or receipts is at least $1,250,000.

entity_level_taxes.name: Minimum fee
entity_level_taxes.notes: Applies when Minnesota property + payroll + sales/receipts >= $1,250,000 (2025); tiered amounts per Minn. Stat. 290.0922, indexed. Also built-in gains / excess passive income taxes at entity level.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Elective pass-through entity tax for S corps and partnerships, computed at 9.85% (top individual rate) on the entity's PTE income (Schedule PTE).

sources.title: 2025 Form M8 instructions
sources.quote: Multiply line 51 of Schedule KS by 9.85% (0.0985)

personal_exemption.notes: No personal exemption for filer/spouse; dependent exemption $5,300 each. HOH standard deduction $23,000; HOH brackets 5.35% to $41,010, 6.8% to $164,800, 7.85% to $270,060, 9.85% above.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: Net investment income tax of 1% on net investment income over $1M (since 2024) - not re-read today.

sources.title: MN Revenue press release 2025-12-16: 2026 brackets, standard deduction, dependent exemption
sources.quote: Single up to $33,310 5.35% ... $203,151 and over 9.85%; Married Filing Joint: $30,600; Single: $15,300; Dependent exemption: $5,300

estimated_tax.required_if: tax after credits expected to be $500 or more (no underpayment addition below $500)
estimated_tax.notes: Due dates follow the federal schedule (not read on revenue.state.mn.us, which blocks automated reading).

unemployment_2026.notes: uimn.org/mn.gov unreachable or blocked. Secondary sources: 2026 wage base $44,000, new employer rates vary by industry (1%+), plus 0.40% base tax rate - not verified. Minnesota Paid Leave premiums began 2026 (not researched).

notable: Top rate 9.85% from $203,150 single / $337,930 joint in 2026 (https://www.revenue.state.mn.us/press-release/2025-12-16/minnesota-income-tax-brackets-standard-deduction-and-dependent-exemption)
LLC annual renewal is free, but forgetting it leads to administrative dissolution (https://www.sos.mn.gov/media/1687/businessentityfees.pdf)
S corps and partnerships owe a minimum fee once Minnesota property+payroll+sales reach $1.25M (https://www.revenue.state.mn.us/sites/default/files/2026-07/m8-inst-25.pdf)
uncertain: revenue.state.mn.us, sos.mn.gov and uimn.org block automated reading (Radware). Bracket figures read via WebFetch of the official press release; LLC fees from statute and a 2017 SOS fee schedule (online $155 may have changed).
2026 minimum fee tiers and threshold not read (2025 threshold $1,250,000).
SUTA 2026 wage base and new employer rate not verified.
Standard deduction phase-out for high incomes and the 1% net investment income tax not verified today.
